name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
ministry: Ministry of Education, Department of School Education & Literacy
benefit_summary: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000/month) for meritorious students from economically weaker sections studying in Classes 9-12

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
ministry: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
benefit_summary: ₹12,000/year for the first 3 years of UG courses and ₹20,000/year for the 4th/5th professional years and PG, for meritorious students from the top 20 percentile of Class 12 boards

name: PM YASASVI Scholarship
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit_summary: Scholarship of up to ₹1,25,000 per annum for OBC/EBC/DNT students studying in Class 9 or Class 11 at government, government-aided, or private schools

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education
benefit_summary: ₹50,000 per annum for girl students admitted to the first year of diploma/degree technical courses at AICTE-approved institutions (up to two girls per family)
benefit_amount: ₹50,000 per annum (max 3 years degree / 2 years diploma lateral entry)

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially Abled Students
ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education
benefit_summary: ₹50,000 per annum for specially-abled students (minimum 40% disability) pursuing diploma/degree technical education at AICTE-approved institutions

name: Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
benefit_summary: Full tuition fee reimbursement (ceiling ₹2 lakh/year in private institutions) plus academic allowance of ₹86,000 in the first year and ₹41,000 in subsequent years, for SC students admitted to notified premier institutions (IITs, IIMs, NITs, AIIMS, etc.)
benefit_amount: Up to ₹2 lakh/year tuition + ₹86,000/₹41,000 academic allowance

name: National Fellowship for OBC Students
ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit_summary: Junior Research Fellowship for unemployed OBC candidates pursuing full-time M.Phil./Ph.D. programmes, approximately 1000 fellowships per year

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
benefit_summary: Scholarship for minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Buddhist, Parsi) students studying Class 11 onwards, covering admission/tuition fees and maintenance allowance

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Micro Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_summary: ₹15,000 toolkit grant, skill training with ₹500/day stipend, and collateral-free loans up to ₹3 lakh at 5% concessional interest for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 trades
benefit_amount: ₹15,000 toolkit grant + up to ₹3 lakh collateral-free loan

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit_summary: Interest-subsidised loans up to ₹2 lakh (individual) or ₹10 lakh (group/SHG) for urban poor to set up micro-enterprises, plus skill training, placement support, and shelter for the urban homeless
benefit_amount: Loan up to ₹2 lakh (individual) / ₹10 lakh (group) with interest subvention

name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
benefit_summary: Free industry-oriented short-term skill training, certification, and placement assistance for youth, with a monetary reward on successful certification

name: National Career Service (NCS) registration
benefit_summary: Free online job portal offering job matching, career counselling at Model Career Centres, skill-training referrals, and job fair access to job seekers nationwide

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
benefit_summary: Legal guarantee of 100 days of wage employment per financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work
benefit_amount: State-notified minimum wage for up to 100 days/year per household

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry
benefit_summary: Seed funding of up to ₹20 lakh as a grant for proof-of-concept/prototype development and up to ₹50 lakh via convertible debentures or debt instruments for market entry, for DPIIT-recognised early-stage startups
benefit_amount: Up to ₹20 lakh grant + up to ₹50 lakh debt/convertible debentures
